claims: Herb Sendek is the head coach of the Santa Clara University men's basketball team.
Herb Sendek is currently in his 10th season as of 2026.
Santa Clara University men's basketball team lost 89-84 in overtime to Kentucky in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
Herb Sendek unsuccessfully attempted to call a timeout just before Kentucky's game-tying buzzer-beater in regulation.
Herb Sendek stated he "unequivocally" called for a timeout.
Video evidence shows Herb Sendek signaling for a timeout after Allen Graves hit a 3-pointer.
Allen Graves hit a 3-pointer to put Santa Clara up 73-70 with 2 seconds remaining.
The referees did not grant the timeout.
Kentucky scored immediately and forced overtime.
Bill Carr is a Santa Clara head coach for women's basketball.
Rusty Filter is a Santa Clara head coach for baseball.
